terms.title: Agent
terms.description: A model-backed or otherwise autonomous review agent produced the result.

terms.title: Deterministic sensor
terms.description: A deterministic scanner, analyzer, or measurement tool produced the result.

terms.title: Human
terms.description: A human reviewer directly produced the result.

terms.title: Imported
terms.description: The result was imported from a legacy or external contract with known provenance.

terms.title: Unknown producer
terms.description: Available source data does not establish who produced the result.

terms.title: Available
terms.description: All evidence required by the applicable profile was available.

terms.title: Partial
terms.description: Some but not all evidence required by the applicable profile was available.

terms.title: Unavailable
terms.description: Required evidence could not be obtained; this never implies a passing assessment.

terms.title: Pass
terms.description: The evidence establishes conformance for the assessed scope.

terms.title: Concern
terms.description: The evidence establishes a material concern without establishing failure.

terms.title: Fail
terms.description: The evidence establishes non-conformance for the assessed scope.

terms.title: Inconclusive
terms.description: The available evidence cannot establish pass or fail.

terms.title: Not applicable
terms.description: The assessment does not apply to the exact subject.

terms.title: Not assessed
terms.description: No assessment has yet been performed for the exact subject.

terms.title: Improved
terms.description: The comparison establishes an improvement.

terms.title: Regressed
terms.description: The comparison establishes a regression.

terms.title: Mixed change
terms.description: The comparison contains both improvements and regressions.

terms.title: Unchanged
terms.description: The compared quality state is materially unchanged.

terms.title: No observed delta
terms.description: No quality delta was observed in the comparison evidence.

terms.title: Inconclusive change
terms.description: The evidence cannot establish the direction of change.

terms.title: Allow
terms.description: The identified policy permits the subject to proceed.

terms.title: Warn
terms.description: The identified policy permits progress with an explicit warning.

terms.title: Block
terms.description: The identified policy blocks progress.

terms.title: Defer
terms.description: The identified policy defers disposition pending another decision or evidence source.

terms.title: Critical
terms.description: Highest-impact finding severity under the active scoring policy.

terms.title: High
terms.description: High-impact finding severity under the active scoring policy.

terms.title: Medium
terms.description: Medium-impact finding severity under the active scoring policy.

terms.title: Low
terms.description: Low-impact finding severity under the active scoring policy.

terms.title: Informational
terms.description: Informational finding severity under the active scoring policy.

terms.title: Open
terms.description: The issue is active and has no superseding lifecycle disposition.

terms.title: Accepted risk
terms.description: An authorized actor explicitly accepted the issue risk.

terms.title: Waived
terms.description: An authorized actor waived the issue under an explicit basis.

terms.title: False positive
terms.description: An authorized actor determined that the issue does not represent the claimed defect.

terms.title: Resolved
terms.description: A lifecycle event establishes that the issue has been resolved.

terms.title: Source code
terms.description: Evidence located in source code.

terms.title: Test result
terms.description: Evidence produced by a test execution or test report.

terms.title: Runtime measurement
terms.description: Evidence measured from a running system.

terms.title: Tool result
terms.description: Structured or textual evidence emitted by a tool.

terms.title: Artifact
terms.description: Evidence retained as a referenced artifact.

terms.title: Document
terms.description: Evidence retained in a document or preserved text value.

terms.title: Human attestation
terms.description: Evidence explicitly attested by a human actor.

terms.title: Code correctness
terms.description: Correct behavior, failure handling, and conformance to the intended code contract.

terms.title: Code architecture
terms.description: Architecture boundaries, responsibilities, coupling, and maintainability.

terms.title: General security
terms.description: General security posture when a narrower security aspect does not apply.

terms.title: Secrets
terms.description: Secret exposure, storage, handling, and rotation risks.

terms.title: Dependencies
terms.description: Security risk from third-party packages and dependency resolution.

terms.title: Authentication and authorization
terms.description: Identity verification, permissions, and access-control enforcement.

terms.title: Input validation
terms.description: Validation, normalization, and safe use of untrusted input.

terms.title: Configuration and infrastructure as code
terms.description: Secure configuration and infrastructure-as-code posture.

terms.title: Boundary exposure
terms.description: Exposure and protection of trust and system boundaries.

terms.title: Business-logic security
terms.description: Abuse paths and security invariants in business flows.

terms.title: Attack coverage
terms.description: Coverage of applicable attack classes and their required evidence.

terms.title: General performance
terms.description: Performance behavior and resource use when a narrower aspect does not apply.

terms.title: Change risk
terms.description: Risk introduced or altered by a change set.

terms.title: Change test evidence
terms.description: Adequacy of test evidence for a change set.

terms.title: Scope discipline
terms.description: Whether a change remains coherent and appropriately scoped.

terms.title: Architecture drift
terms.description: Architecture drift introduced or revealed by a change set.
